title: 第18章 云州境况
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
翌日，天色渐亮。

    陆舟风尘仆仆归来，面露疲色。

    这《雷音轰》虽说赶路不错，但一整晚的奔波，还是让其气血大损，周身气力虚浮。

    他取出一枚从流云商会购得的丹药随口服下。

    药力入体，缓缓滋养亏虚气血。

    在这个世界，丹药是不可多得之物，因其本质就是气血精华的浓缩。

    在补充气血，催动真元，或修复肉身等等方面，都有着不错的功效。

    其按照气血浓郁程度，共分为一到九品，以及最好的神级丹药。

    除此之外，一些特殊方法炼制的丹药，还会被赋予特殊能力。

    不过这些能力往往属于禁忌，伴随着强大的副作用。

    陆舟手中乃是一枚七品丹药，这种品质，在寻常武者中已是不可多见，每一枚都视如珍宝。

    毕竟这可是真正的救命之物！

    服下丹药后，气血得到补充，陆舟明显脸色好了不少。

    临近营地，他本想偷摸摸回去，不料迎面撞见了周川。

    “属下参见王爷。” 周川立刻躬身行礼。

    陆舟眉峰微挑，沉声问道：“你怎么在这？”

    他暗自猜想，莫不是对方在跟踪自己。

    周川见状连忙低声解释：“昨夜刘傲找过王爷，我说您有事……”

    说话间，他瞥了眼陆舟身上的尘土，躬身道：“属下特意在这等王爷，以防止出现纰漏。”

    显然，周川也一夜未眠。

    听闻此言，陆舟心中顿时通透，暗自感慨周川心思缜密，处事周全。

    他微微颔首，淡然道：“本王去办了点事。”

    周川素来识趣，并未打探具体内容，只躬身问道：“王爷可有吩咐，属下随时听候差遣。”

    “让仙儿给我准备一盆温水。”陆舟说着，朝着营帐走去。

    他太累了，得睡一觉才是。

    ……

    车队继续往南。

    袁氏父子一事，在茶州掀起了巨大波动，甚至惊动了高坐庙堂的那位武皇！

    但这些，都与陆舟无关。

    此刻的他，已经离开了茶州地界，来到了他的领地——云州。
content_en:
The next day, the sky is getting brighter.

    Lu Zhou returned home after a long journey and looked tired.

    Although this "Thunder Sound Boom" was on a good journey, running around all night still greatly damaged his energy and blood, and his whole body was weak.

    He took out a pill purchased from Liuyun Chamber of Commerce and swallowed it.

    The medicinal power enters the body and slowly nourishes deficient Qi and blood.

    In this world, elixirs are rare things because their essence is the concentration of the essence of Qi and blood.

    It has good effects in replenishing qi and blood, stimulating true energy, or repairing the physical body, etc.

    According to the richness of Qi and blood, they are divided into grades one to nine, as well as the best god-level elixirs.

    In addition, some elixirs refined by special methods will also be endowed with special abilities.

    However, these abilities are often taboo and come with powerful side effects.

    Lu Zhou held a seventh-grade elixir in his hand. This kind of quality was rare among ordinary warriors, and each one was regarded as a treasure.

    After all, this is a real life-saver!

    After taking the elixir, his energy and blood were replenished, and Lu Zhou's complexion obviously improved a lot.

    Approaching the camp, he wanted to sneak back, but unexpectedly bumped into Zhou Chuan.

    "I see you, Your Majesty." Zhou Chuan immediately bowed and saluted.

    Lu Zhou raised his eyebrows slightly and asked in a deep voice, "Why are you here?"

    He secretly guessed that the other party was following him.

    Seeing this, Zhou Chuan quickly explained in a low voice: "Liu Ao came to see the prince last night, and I said that you had something to do..."

    As he spoke, he glanced at the dust on Lu Zhou's body, bowed and said, "This subordinate is waiting for the prince here specifically to prevent any mistakes."

    Obviously, Zhou Chuan also stayed up all night.

    After hearing this, Lu Zhou's heart suddenly became enlightened, and he secretly lamented that Zhou Chuan was thoughtful and thoughtful.

    He nodded slightly and said calmly: "I have gone to do something."

    Zhou Chuan has always been knowledgeable and did not inquire about the specific content. He only bowed and asked, "Do you have any orders, Your Majesty? My subordinates are always at your disposal."

    "Ask Xian'er to prepare a basin of warm water for me." Lu Zhou said and walked towards the tent.

    He was too tired and needed to take a nap.

    …

    The convoy continued south.

    The incident between Yuan and his son caused huge fluctuations in Chazhou, and even alarmed the Emperor Wu who was sitting in the temple!

    But these have nothing to do with Lu Zhou.

    At this moment, he has left the boundaries of Chazhou and arrived at his territory - Yunzhou.
